external_references: Actor and research job IDs are audit metadata only; their referenced rows are deliberately excluded. Restore requires explicit destination actor/job mapping.

portal_company.original_schema: CREATE TABLE "portal_company" ("id" char(32) NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, "name" varchar(200) NOT NULL, "credit_code" varchar(18) NULL UNIQUE, "province" varchar(100) NULL, "city" varchar(100) NULL, "address" varchar(500) NULL, "website" varchar(2000) NULL, "phone" varchar(100) NULL, "contact_name" varchar(100) NULL, "contact_phone" varchar(100) NULL, "email" varchar(254) NULL, "description" text NULL, "source" text NULL, "verified_on" date NULL, "version" integer unsigned NOT NULL CHECK ("version" >= 0), "created_at" datetime NOT NULL, "updated_at" datetime NOT NULL, "created_by_id" bigint NOT NULL REFERENCES "portal_user" ("id") DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED, "updated_by_id" bigint NOT NULL REFERENCES "portal_user" ("id") DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED, "website_kind" varchar(20) NOT NULL, CONSTRAINT "baichuan_company_name" CHECK (NOT ("name" = '')), CONSTRAINT "baichuan_company_version" CHECK ("version" >= 1))

portal_companyqualification.original_schema: CREATE TABLE "portal_companyqualification" ("id" char(32) NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, "category" varchar(20) NOT NULL, "status" varchar(10) NOT NULL, "grade" varchar(1) NULL, "certificate_no" varchar(200) NULL, "valid_until" date NULL, "source" text NULL, "verified_on" date NULL, "company_id" char(32) NOT NULL REFERENCES "portal_company" ("id") DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED, CONSTRAINT "baichuan_qual_category" CHECK ("category" IN ('electronic', 'labor', 'cs', 'cmmi', 'ccrc', 'itss', 'security')), CONSTRAINT "baichuan_qual_status" CHECK ("status" IN ('UNKNOWN', 'ABSENT', 'PRESENT')), CONSTRAINT "baichuan_qual_no_grade" CHECK (("status" = 'PRESENT' OR "grade" IS NULL)), CONSTRAINT "baichuan_qual_grade" CHECK ((("category" = 'labor' AND "grade" IS NULL) OR ("category" = 'electronic' AND "grade" IN ('1', '2')) OR ("category" = 'cs' AND "grade" IN ('1', '2', '3', '4', '5')) OR ("category" = 'cmmi' AND "grade" IN ('3', '4', '5')) OR ("category" = 'ccrc' AND "grade" IN ('1', '2', '3')) OR ("category" = 'itss' AND "grade" IN ('1', '2', '3', '4')) OR ("category" = 'security' AND "grade" IN ('1', '2', '3')) OR ("category" IN ('electronic', 'labor', 'cs', 'cmmi', 'ccrc', 'itss', 'security') AND "grade" IS NULL))))

portal_companyperson.original_schema: CREATE TABLE "portal_companyperson" ("id" char(32) NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, "name" varchar(100) NOT NULL, "department" varchar(200) NULL, "position" varchar(200) NULL, "reports_to_text" varchar(500) NULL, "specialties" text NULL, "credentials" text NULL, "achievements" text NULL, "source" text NULL, "verified_on" date NULL, "company_id" char(32) NOT NULL REFERENCES "portal_company" ("id") DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED, CONSTRAINT "baichuan_person_name" CHECK (NOT ("name" = '')))

portal_baichuanevidence.original_schema: CREATE TABLE "portal_baichuanevidence" ("id" char(32) NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, "created_at" datetime NOT NULL, "scope" varchar(100) NOT NULL, "source_type" varchar(30) NOT NULL, "url" varchar(2000) NOT NULL, "import_ref" varchar(500) NOT NULL, "publisher" varchar(300) NOT NULL, "title" varchar(500) NOT NULL, "retrieved_at" datetime NOT NULL, "published_on" date NULL, "verified_on" date NULL, "content_hash" varchar(64) NOT NULL, "excerpt" text NOT NULL, "locator" text NOT NULL CHECK ((JSON_VALID("locator") OR "locator" IS NULL)), "subject" text NOT NULL CHECK ((JSON_VALID("subject") OR "subject" IS NULL)), "access_status" varchar(30) NOT NULL, "storage_ref" varchar(500) NOT NULL, "created_by_id" bigint NULL REFERENCES "portal_user" ("id") DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED)

portal_baichuanfactrevision.original_schema: CREATE TABLE "portal_baichuanfactrevision" ("id" char(32) NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, "created_at" datetime NOT NULL, "field" varchar(100) NOT NULL, "object_id" char(32) NULL, "old_value" text NULL CHECK ((JSON_VALID("old_value") OR "old_value" IS NULL)), "new_value" text NULL CHECK ((JSON_VALID("new_value") OR "new_value" IS NULL)), "execution_identity" varchar(200) NOT NULL, "baseline_version" integer unsigned NOT NULL CHECK ("baseline_version" >= 0), "verification_status" varchar(20) NOT NULL, "review_status" varchar(20) NOT NULL, "reason" text NOT NULL, "actor_id" bigint NOT NULL REFERENCES "portal_user" ("id") DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED, "company_id" char(32) NOT NULL REFERENCES "portal_company" ("id") DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED, "evidence_id" char(32) NULL REFERENCES "portal_baichuanevidence" ("id") DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED, "supersedes_id" char(32) NULL REFERENCES "portal_baichuanfactrevision" ("id") DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED, CONSTRAINT "bc_revision_baseline" CHECK ("baseline_version" >= 1))

portal_baichuancertificate.original_schema: CREATE TABLE "portal_baichuancertificate" ("id" char(32) NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, "created_at" datetime NOT NULL, "category" varchar(100) NOT NULL, "raw_category" varchar(500) NOT NULL, "holder_type" varchar(30) NOT NULL, "holder_name" varchar(300) NOT NULL, "holder_company_id" char(32) NULL, "standard" varchar(500) NOT NULL, "scope_text" text NOT NULL, "grade" varchar(100) NOT NULL, "raw_grade" varchar(200) NOT NULL, "certificate_no" varchar(300) NOT NULL, "issuer" varchar(500) NOT NULL, "valid_from" date NULL, "valid_until" date NULL, "assertion_status" varchar(10) NOT NULL, "verification_status" varchar(20) NOT NULL, "verified_at" datetime NULL, "revocation_status" varchar(20) NOT NULL, "legacy_qualification_id" char(32) NULL UNIQUE, "fingerprint" varchar(64) NOT NULL, "updated_at" datetime NOT NULL, "company_id" char(32) NOT NULL REFERENCES "portal_company" ("id") DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED, "evidence_id" char(32) NULL REFERENCES "portal_baichuanevidence" ("id") DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED, "source_revision_id" char(32) NULL REFERENCES "portal_baichuanfactrevision" ("id") DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED, CONSTRAINT "bc_cert_assertion" CHECK ("assertion_status" IN ('PRESENT', 'ABSENT', 'UNKNOWN')), CONSTRAINT "bc_cert_verification" CHECK ("verification_status" IN ('verified', 'unverified', 'conflict', 'inaccessible', 'superseded')), CONSTRAINT "bc_cert_date_order" CHECK (("valid_from" IS NULL OR "valid_until" IS NULL OR "valid_until" >= ("valid_from"))))

portal_baichuanqualificationrule.original_schema: CREATE TABLE "portal_baichuanqualificationrule" ("id" char(32) NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, "created_at" datetime NOT NULL, "category" varchar(100) NOT NULL, "version" integer unsigned NOT NULL CHECK ("version" >= 0), "aliases" text NOT NULL CHECK ((JSON_VALID("aliases") OR "aliases" IS NULL)), "legal_grades" text NOT NULL CHECK ((JSON_VALID("legal_grades") OR "legal_grades" IS NULL)), "grade_relations" text NOT NULL CHECK ((JSON_VALID("grade_relations") OR "grade_relations" IS NULL)), "standard" varchar(500) NOT NULL, "applicable_from" date NULL, "applicable_until" date NULL, "enabled" bool NOT NULL, "evidence_id" char(32) NOT NULL REFERENCES "portal_baichuanevidence" ("id") DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED, CONSTRAINT "bc_rule_category_version" UNIQUE ("category", "version"), CONSTRAINT "bc_rule_version" CHECK ("version" >= 1))

portal_baichuanresearchmanifest.original_schema: CREATE TABLE "portal_baichuanresearchmanifest" ("id" char(32) NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, "created_at" datetime NOT NULL, "scope" varchar(100) NOT NULL, "company_versions" text NOT NULL CHECK ((JSON_VALID("company_versions") OR "company_versions" IS NULL)), "total_count" integer unsigned NOT NULL CHECK ("total_count" >= 0), "fields" text NOT NULL CHECK ((JSON_VALID("fields") OR "fields" IS NULL)), "job_id" char(32) NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES "portal_baichuanjob" ("id") DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED, "owner_id" bigint NOT NULL REFERENCES "portal_user" ("id") DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED, "parent_manifest_id" char(32) NULL REFERENCES "portal_baichuanresearchmanifest" ("id") DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED)

portal_baichuanresearchitem.original_schema: CREATE TABLE "portal_baichuanresearchitem" ("id" char(32) NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, "created_at" datetime NOT NULL, "company_version" integer unsigned NOT NULL CHECK ("company_version" >= 0), "field" varchar(100) NOT NULL, "status" varchar(30) NOT NULL, "verification_status" varchar(20) NOT NULL, "checkpoint" text NOT NULL CHECK ((JSON_VALID("checkpoint") OR "checkpoint" IS NULL)), "attempts" integer unsigned NOT NULL CHECK ("attempts" >= 0), "reason" text NOT NULL, "updated_at" datetime NOT NULL, "company_id" char(32) NOT NULL REFERENCES "portal_company" ("id") DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED, "evidence_id" char(32) NULL REFERENCES "portal_baichuanevidence" ("id") DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED, "manifest_id" char(32) NOT NULL REFERENCES "portal_baichuanresearchmanifest" ("id") DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED, CONSTRAINT "bc_research_item_key" UNIQUE ("manifest_id", "company_id", "field"))
